title: Capture the next 20 owed Zoning Resolution sections the worked readings of options 5, 6 and 7 rest on that are not yet captured (community-facility use permission 22-131..22-135, community-facility special permits 74-902/74-903, required recreation space 23-63, the community-facility rear-yard-modification subtree 24-37/24-38/24-39/24-392/24-393, the commercial rear-yard-modification subtree 33-27/33-28/33-30/33-302/33-303, and the mixed-building residential-bulk routing 35-23/35-24), and correct the law library's capture states for the sections this pass captures. Documents only: source-text snapshots in the existing zr_section_snapshot/v1 shape with byte-identical bundled copies; no rule, no reading of the text for any lot, no computed figure, no eligibility determination.
objective: Capture, from the official NYC DCP Zoning Resolution portal (zoningresolution.planning.nyc.gov), the 20 sections that the worked readings of options 5, 6 and 7 for the benchmark R6B/C2-2 lot rest on and that are NOT in docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1/, ordered so the sections the next reference case (docs/reference-cases/R6B/cases/benchmark-options-2-3-6-7.json, options 2/3/6/7) needs come first: (A) community-facility use permission, Use Group III children of 22-13 -- 22-131 (general use allowances; TWO TABLES A and B keyed by Residence District with the symbols the page's own legend defines, verified node 22415, 12/5/2024), 22-132 (uses subject to size limitations, 'S', node 22416, 6/6/2024), 22-133 (uses subject to additional conditions, 'P', node 22417, 12/5/2024), 22-134 (uses permitted by special permit, '0', node 22418, 12/5/2024), 22-135 (additional provisions for parking requirement category, '*', node 22419, 12/5/2024); (B) community-facility special permits -- 74-902 (certain CF uses in R1/R2 and certain C districts, node 19198, 6/6/2024), 74-903 (certain CF uses in R3-R12 and certain C districts, node 19199, 3/22/2016); (C) option 2/3 senior -- 23-63 (Required Recreation Space in Multiple Dwelling Residences, pointed to inside the AIRS definition by the benchmark reference case, node 17505, 12/5/2024); (D) the community-facility rear-yard-modification subtree the benchmark case cites as 'subject to 24-37/38/39' (24-391 already captured): 24-37 (Special Provisions for Shallow Interior Lots, node 17658, 12/5/2024), 24-38 (Special Provisions for Through Lots, node 17659, 12/5/2024), 24-39 (Other Special Provisions for Rear Yards -- PARENT heading, node 17662, 12/5/2024; children 24-391 captured, 24-392/24-393 captured here), 24-392 (Along short dimension of block), 24-393 (For zoning lots with multiple rear lot lines); (E) the commercial rear-yard-modification subtree option 5 cites (33-301 already captured): 33-27 (Special Provisions for Shallow Interior Lots, node 17740, 6/6/2024), 33-28 (Special Provisions for Through Lots, node 17741, 4/30/2008), 33-30 (Other Special Provisions for Rear Yards -- PARENT heading, node 17749, 12/15/1961; children 33-301 captured, 33-302/33-303 captured here), 33-302 (Along short dimension of block, node 17751, 12/5/2024), 33-303 (For zoning lots with multiple rear lot lines, node 17752, 4/30/2008 -- carries two DIAGRAMS labelled 33-303a and 33-303c that are images: capture them as an image/pointer note the way Appendix F is a pointer capture, never transcribe or invent the figure); (F) mixed-building residential-bulk routing option 5/6 cite -- 35-23 (Residential Bulk Regulations in Other C1/C2 or in C3-C6 Districts -> 34-112 residential equivalent, node 18264, 12/5/2024), 35-24 (Applicability of Residential Bulk Rules to Non-residential Portions of Mixed Buildings, node 22817, 12/5/2024). Each capture is one JSON in the existing zr_section_snapshot/v1 shape (templates: docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1/zr-24-33.snapshot.json and zr-23-344.snapshot.json; a table-bearing section: zr-24-33 / the M3-T009 pattern): official HTML node request plus the print/PDF entityprint cross-check (entityprint/pdf/node/<id>), both channels sha256-pinned (or the documented 504/403 fallback, disclosed), the page's own Last Amended stamp, verbatim_excerpt with #term# markers and list letters taken from the official PRINT (the HTML <ol> can restart a list -- M3-T008 G1 F1), any table carried cell-by-cell in the structured tables field with a placeholder token in the excerpt and the section's OWN legend quoted (the M3-T010 F1 lesson: quote each section's own legend; 22-131's A/B tables use the symbols the page's legend defines), content_digest_sha256 = sha256(verbatim_excerpt), extraction_status extracted_draft, raw_html_verified false, the ADR-007 not-professionally-reviewed label. Each lands in docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1/ AND as a byte-identical copy in services/api/app/_zr_snapshots/v1/ produced by RUNNING services/api/scripts/sync_zr_snapshots.py (never edited). Every section number, title, URL, node id and Last Amended date is taken from the page read for this pass (the node ids and dates above are the planner's verification of 2026-10-15 and must be re-read, not trusted). A listed node that does not exist or was renumbered is reported in the producer report, never invented (S4). THEN correct the law library's capture states for exactly the sections this pass captures: option-06-07-community-facility.md (mark 22-131..22-135 CAPTURED where it currently reads '22-131...22-135 NOT CAPTURED'; add 74-902/74-903 and the 24-37/24-38/24-39/24-392/24-393 CF rear-yard-modification sections where it names them), option-05-shops-with-residences.md (mark 33-27/33-28/33-30/33-302/33-303 and 35-23/35-24 CAPTURED where its 'capture owed' item names them), options-sections.md (the master list capture-state cells for all 20 and 23-63), and the index docs/zoning-law-library/benchmark-r6b-sections.json (add capture-status entries for the 20 new sections where it lists them; valid JSON). Capture-state corrections only, no new reading, no value change. Documents only: no rule, no reading for a lot, no computed number, no eligibility determination.
business_reason: The benchmark reference case docs/reference-cases/R6B/cases/benchmark-options-2-3-6-7.json (options 2/3/6/7) and the option-05/06-07 readings cite these 20 sections, but they are read only live or not at all: the community-facility use-permission precision for option 6/7 ('which Use Group III uses are as-of-right vs size-limited 22-132 vs special-permit 22-134 in R6B -- not sure; next step read 22-131..22-134' in option-06-07) rests on 22-131..22-135 and the 74-902/74-903 special permits, none captured; option 2/3's AIRS senior reading points inside the definition to 23-63 Required Recreation Space, not captured; the benchmark case states the CF 30-ft rear yard is 'subject to 24-37/38/39' and option 5's 20-ft commercial rear yard is 'except 33-27 shallow interior lots / 33-28 through lots / 33-30', with the whole 24-39 and 33-30 modification subtrees read live only; option 5/6's mixed-building residential-bulk routing cites 35-23/35-24. A rule or a reference case may cite a section only once it is captured with provenance (CLAUDE.md principles 2, 3, 12). This is the next owed subset after M3-T010, which named exactly this remaining set in its own business_reason ('Remaining owed captures ... 22-131..22-135, 74-902/74-903, 23-63, 35-23, 35-24 ... follow in a later task, one capture run at a time') and deferred it. DEFERRED, NOT in this batch (listed for later, never silently omitted -- S8): 23-154 (HTTP 403 on WebFetch and the browser-UA GET fallback confirmed again 2026-10-15; not load-bearing for the benchmark per option-02-03's 27-111 correction; needs the print/PDF node channel or a durable access-blocked note in its own task); the 25-30 non-residential/community-facility parking subtree 25-31..25-37 (node 17559; option 10's '25-30+ NOT CAPTURED', a large family for a dedicated parking task); the Article VII Chapter 7 district-boundary split family 77-01/77-11/77-12/77-21/77-211/77-22/77-24/77-25/77-26/77-27/77-28 (option 8 Reading B -- the comparer found the district-boundary meaning is not this lot's situation, 77-xx deferred); 23-38 (Special Rules for Certain Areas, node 22767) and 23-72 (Portions of Community District 12 Brooklyn, node 22778) cited by the short-block-rear-yard reference case but Brooklyn/special-geography, not the Queens benchmark; the 12-10 'residential building' term named by M3-T010's owed note (verify whether it is a distinct 12-10 defined term before capturing; report, never invent -- 'side lot line' is already captured as zr-12-10-lot-line-side).

acceptance_scenarios.then: the file is in the zr_section_snapshot/v1 shape; content_digest_sha256 == sha256(verbatim_excerpt); it names its channel and is sha256-pinned on both the HTML and the print/PDF channel (or records the documented 504/403 fallback); and SnapshotStore().load() / app.rules.snapshots.load_snapshot_file loads it without error (unique snapshot_id matching the filename)

acceptance_scenarios.then: --check exits 0; the bundle test's bundled==canonical membership assertion still holds (20 canonical and 20 bundled added together), each bundled copy is byte-identical to its canonical source, and test_default_store_resolves_to_packaged_location's store.load() validates every new file's digest

it stays green; the benchmark fixture cites none of the 20 new sections as a rendered law link, so no rendered href changes; each new capture's request_url is the official article/chapter/section page

risks: RISK 1: 22-131 carries two symbol tables (A and B) keyed by Residence District with a legend (0, *, S, P, E, G, B ...). Carry the tables cell-by-cell in the structured tables field with a placeholder token in the excerpt and quote the section's OWN legend verbatim (the M3-T010 F1 lesson). Do not read any cell as an R6B permission for any use -- that is a reading, out of scope.

RISK 2: 33-303 carries two diagrams (33-303a, 33-303c) that are images. Record them as an image/pointer note the way Appendix F is captured (pointer only); never transcribe, redraw, or state a dimension from a figure.

RISK 3: 12/5/2024 City of Yes renumbering -- take every number, title, node id and Last Amended date from the page read this pass; the planner's verification (2026-10-15) gives node ids 22415/22416/22417/22418/22419 (22-131..135), 19198/19199 (74-902/903), 17505 (23-63), 17658/17659/17662 (24-37/38/39), 17740/17741/17749/17751/17752 (33-27/28/30/302/303), 18264/22817 (35-23/24) but these are a cross-check, not a substitute for the live read. Report, never invent, a missing or renumbered node (S4).

RISK 4: One capture run at a time against the official site -- M3-T011 must not fetch concurrently with any other live capture run. 23-154 (HTTP 403) and the 25-30 parking subtree and the 77-xx family are out of scope, deferred to their own tasks.

RISK 5: Capture-claim drift -- run the producer capture-claim check so the folder listing equals the claimed set; pdftotext drops hyphens in section numbers and wraps table cells, so keep the HTML form canonical and make the cross-check hyphen/wrap-tolerant (M3-T009 lesson).

RISK 6: Parent-heading sections (24-39, 33-30) carry little body text and point to their children; capture the heading text verbatim as the page shows it and list the not-in-batch children in the report (S8); do not synthesize a body.
